affected_system: roadway, bridge, sidewalk, signal, and public right-of-way asset network
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for road and bridge deterioration and maintenance demand
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for road and bridge deterioration and maintenance demand
pair inspection-history, load, climate, and treatment-conditioned forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Assets, inspections, defects, work orders, costs, traffic, restrictions, and completion are reconciled.
Engineering thresholds and deterioration models are locally reviewed and versioned.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for road and bridge deterioration and maintenance demand.

constraints.description: The road and bridge asset management forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: public works asset manager and chief infrastructure engineer
decision_question: What probabilistic condition, defect, restriction, and maintenance workload should asset managers prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The road and bridge asset management forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: road and bridge deterioration and maintenance demand
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for road and bridge deterioration and maintenance demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: inspection-history, load, climate, and treatment-conditioned forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: lane- and asset-days below condition targets

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting road and bridge deterioration and maintenance demand, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: lane- and asset-days below condition targets
distributional gap in lane- and asset-days below condition targets
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not present modeled deterioration as an inspection, failure, closure, or safety prediction.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for road and bridge deterioration and maintenance demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast road and bridge deterioration and work demand
transportability_risks: Materials, climate, loading, standards, inspection, procurement, and unit costs differ.
Service requests can reveal workload but not structural condition or safety.
